Subject: Thanks for the discovery — next steps & evaluation kickoff

Hi Jonathan / Elena,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand Acme's ingestion pipeline, latency targets, and the internal guardrails around data retention. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can get an evaluation kicked off smoothly:

- Goal: 2-4 week pilot to validate latency and cost profile on your representative prompt set, and confirm integration approach for private deployment.
- Success criteria (draft): average inference latency <= 250ms p50 for 512-token requests; overall cost within target budget; no data leaving your VPC during private eval.
- Proposed attendees for kickoff: Jonathan (PM), Elena (Data Eng), Connor Obrien (Redwood SE), Dev Patel (Redwood Solutions), myself.
- Proposed agenda (45-60 min): intro + goals (5), trial plan & timeline (10), prompt set & evals (15), technical deep dive (20), next steps & responsibilities (5).

Can we schedule the evaluation kickoff next week? I have availability: Thu Mar 18 10:00-11:00 PT or Mon Mar 21 13:00-14:00 PT. Please let me know which works best and if any other folks should join. I attached our evaluation template and a quick mutual action plan to help scope the pilot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
